goals.title: Add multi_run dataclasses and paired statistical primitives
goals.description: Create src/secreqgen/evaluation/multi_run.py with the RunStatistics and PairedTestResult dataclasses and the two pure statistical functions: cohens_d_z_paired (returns numeric d_z plus a Cohen-1988 label) and paired_test_with_sensitivity (Wilcoxon as primary, paired t-test as sensitivity, Shapiro-Wilk on the differences for normality reporting). No I/O, no pipeline imports. Foundation for every subsequent leaf.

goals.title: Add per-run and per-story aggregation functions
goals.description: Extend multi_run.py with three aggregation helpers that read the existing pipeline output shape: aggregate_runs (mean/std/min/max per metric across N runs, separately for baseline and RAG), collect_per_story_f1 (story_id -> list of per-run F1 values), and per_story_paired_values (returns equal-length baseline/rag lists for any named metric, one entry per story, averaged across runs). Pure functions. Tests build real EvaluationPipelineResult fixtures so we exercise the actual data path the proposal commits to.

goals.title: Add sequential N-run pipeline orchestrator
goals.description: Add run_multi_evaluation to multi_run.py: invoke pipeline.run(stories_path, ground_truth_path) sequentially N times, collect the per-run EvaluationPipelineResult objects in order, and forward an optional progress callback (current, total, phase). Sequential by design (Ollama is single-threaded). The pipeline is mocked in unit tests via MagicMock; an end-to-end test against real Ollama would be a separate manual smoke step.

goals.title: Add report builder and JSON serializer
goals.description: Add the MultiRunReport dataclass plus build_multi_run_report (orchestrates aggregate_runs, runs paired tests on BOTH per-story (PRIMARY) and per-run (sensitivity) axes for F1, computes d_z) and serialize_report (pretty JSON for archival). The per-story result must have n_pairs == story count; the per-run result must have n_pairs == run count. JSON output must round-trip through json.loads without error.

goals.title: Wire compare-runs CLI command and export aggregator
goals.description: Add the compare-runs subcommand to src/secreqgen/cli.py under evaluate_app, with --runs (default 20), --pilot (sets N=10), --output, --match-threshold, --partial-threshold, --context, --model flags. Reuse the same OllamaClient/embedder/retriever/pipeline initialization block as evaluate_run. Export build_multi_run_report from src/secreqgen/evaluation/__init__.py so external callers (and the CLI) can import it from the package root. Validate that input files exist before doing any heavy work.
